card.name: The word of after maximum
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after "a maximum" in dosing or duration limits. It comes just before a number such as days, weeks, doses or mg.

modes.label: Maximum duration
modes.description: "of" after "for a maximum" before a count of days, weeks or doses.
modes.example: Withhold ZEJULA for a maximum<< of>> 28 days and monitor blood counts

modes.label: Maximum dose amount
modes.description: "of" after "to a maximum" before a dose in mg.
modes.example: Limit the dose of citalopram to a maximum<< of>> 20 mg per day.

card.writes: It promotes tokens meaning maximum or limit, which pushes the model to state an upper bound.
card.plain: It marks the spot after "a maximum" where a numeric upper limit on dose or duration comes next.
